zh-CN.title: 花间来日，生日边饰焕新
items: Tab 与聊天页加入玫瑰缎带、香槟金边线和花卉礼盒，让生日氛围贯穿日常聊天。
适配深浅色、手机与桌面，并保留自选聊天背景和气泡。

en.title: A fresh birthday finish
items: Rose ribbons, champagne-gold borders and a floral gift bring birthday details to tabs and chats.
Refined for light and dark modes on mobile and desktop, with your chosen wallpapers and bubbles preserved.
